title: Site-regulated CoNFs-NH 2 @PtNPs nanozyme-based all-in-one portable detection of organophosphorus pesticides integrating deep learning and hardware logic gates

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Site-regulated CoNFs-NH 2 @PtNPs nanozyme-based all-in-one portable detection of organophosphorus pesticides integrating deep learning and hardware logic gates》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Widespread use of organophosphorus pesticides (OPs) has led to pervasive environmental residues and potential human health hazards, making rapid, sensitive, and portable on-site OPs detection urgently needed.
